opening.argument: The central offer is presented as a conditional exchange promotion, not a guaranteed payout. Users who make and execute a margin trade enter a giveaway and have “a chance to win one million yuan worth of VEN and Quantum,” while the smaller token reward requires verification and can be used only once. The narration does direct new users to register through the description and place a normal margin order, making the message an active promotional invitation. But the large giveaway is framed as an opportunity to win, and the smaller rewards are tied to stated eligibility conditions rather than promised unconditionally. The separate daily-profit referral appears only in the description and is not developed as the video's main spoken message.
